result.description: A fictional tabletop drafting instrument for architects and stage designers, the Quanta Loom 14 combines a modular mechanical arm with calibrated guide rails for precision pattern layout on paper and fabric. It is intended for studio work, model-making, and rehearsal planning rather than digital storage or computer graphics. The device features a matte composite body, interchangeable measuring heads, and a compact carrying case for transport between workshops.
